findings.detail: Independent full-field semantic review of all 41 prompts, ordered choices, main explanations, four option reasons and exam title against exact Japanese packet; source meaning, negations, conditions, hypotheticals and supervisor authority retained.
q333 retains normal-distribution ±1σ/±2σ, 68.3%/95.4%; q388 retains hypothetical 300min ×10kg/min=3000kg and 2400/3000=80%; q331 retains 21+23+23+24+29=120g divided by five=24g, no rounding.

Clarified q363 explicitly asks for explanation of the quoted claim’s error, not selection of an incorrect statement; correct index2 preserves distinction between unintended allergen transfer and ingredient labeling. Source hashes, ordered missing membership and correct-reason/main-explanation equality checked.
